items.title: Empo speaks your language
items.detail: Empo now comes in 10 languages and uses the language of your device. To pick another one, go to Settings.

items.title: RPG Maker MV and MZ
items.detail: Empo now plays games made with RPG Maker MV and MZ. Import one the same way as any other game.

items.title: More XP games start
items.detail: Some RPG Maker XP games that stopped at launch, such as Vinemon, now start.

items.title: PSDK games
items.detail: Empo now plays games made with PSDK. Import one the same way you import an RPG Maker game.

items.title: Controls that fit the game
items.detail: Each game gets the on-screen buttons and the settings that its engine supports.

items.title: Game cores
items.detail: See the game cores built into Empo in Settings.
